summary: The base reproduces silent exactness loss whenever a threshold coarse bin contains more than 2048 distinct fp32 candidates. The candidate's progressive exact-key refinement fixes the register and streaming implementations on the assigned gfx950 GPU, including the 2049 boundary and independent signed-subnormal cases, and its new regression passes against a freshly rebuilt JIT library. It does not change the CUDA-only cluster implementation, which still truncates at kMaxNumTie. The original B200 batch-1 N=262144 reproduction dispatches to that cluster implementation, so the candidate is a verified partial architecture-specific fix rather than a full fix for the original issue.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before on base: register, streaming, and N=262144 ROCm cases returned 2048 valid unique indices but had 2048/2048 selected-value mismatches; 2049 candidates already failed with 1791 mismatches. The 2048 boundary and a 5000-way exact tie had zero mismatches. See evidence/base_harness.txt.

At exact candidate commit, all independent cases had 2048 valid unique outputs and zero value-multiset mismatches, including register/streaming overflow, 2048 and 2049 boundaries, exact ties, and values spanning signed fp16-subnormal space. See evidence/candidate_harness.txt.
Candidate regression: 10 passed, 278 deselected on gfx950. See evidence/candidate_regression.txt.
Candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: All numerical and pytest runs used the single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015.

native_rebuild_evidence: A private empty SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR forced compilation of sgl_kernel_jit_dpsk_v4_topk_v2.so from /job/repo/python/sglang/kernels/jit/csrc/deepseek_v4/topk_v2.cuh and /job/repo/python/sglang/kernels/jit/include/sgl_kernel/deepseek_v4/topk_impl.cuh. The resulting gfx950 library and build timestamps are recorded in evidence/candidate_native_files.txt; Python source paths are in evidence/import_paths.txt.
remaining_counterexamples: CUDA TopKCluster still executes min(equal_count, kMaxNumTie) after retaining an arrival-order-limited candidate subset. Any CUDA-dispatched cluster row with more than 2048 fp32-distinct values in its threshold coarse bin can still return the wrong top-k value multiset.
The original issue's batch=1, N=262144 B200 fixture selects the unchanged CUDA cluster path, so it remains a direct source-level counterexample and was not executable on this AMD-only host.
remaining_limitations: No CUDA/B200 device was available, so the unchanged cluster-path failure could not be executed here.
No GLM-5.2 weights, reported 1M-token score dumps, TP8, or multi-node environment were available; no full-model or workload-level claim is made.
The candidate's entire 288-test file was not rerun in this independent review; the issue-specific 10-case regression and eight independent deterministic cases were run.
